    PopupSubtitle.Text = "Current: " .. (KeybindNames[currentKey] or "Unknown") .. "\nPress any key to change or ESC to cancel"

    connection = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
        
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
            KeybindPopup.Visible = false
            currentKeybindChanging = nil

            return

        KeybindPopup.Visible = false
        currentKeybindChanging = nil

    end)

    local SliderCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

    SliderCorner.Parent = SliderBack
    
    local SliderFill = Instance.new("Frame")
    SliderFill.Size = UDim2.new((default - min) / (max - min), 0, 1, 0)
    SliderFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(138, 43, 226)
    SliderFill.BorderSizePixel = 0

    local FillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

    FillCorner.Parent = SliderFill
    
    local SliderButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    SliderButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    SliderButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    SliderButton.Text = ""
    SliderButton.Parent = SliderBack
    
    local dragging = false
    
    SliderButton.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        dragging = true
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
    
    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if dragging then
            local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            local relativePos = mousePos.X - SliderBack.AbsolutePosition.X
            local percentage = math.clamp(relativePos / SliderBack.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
            local value = math.floor(min + (max - min) * percentage)
            
            SliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(percentage, 0, 1, 0)
            Label.Text = text .. ": " .. value
            callback(value)
        end
    end)
    
    return Container
end

local function getHumanoidRootPart()
    local char = getCharacter()
    return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getTargetPart(player)
    if not player.Character then return nil end
    
    if Config.AimbotTarget == "Head" then
        return player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    elseif Config.AimbotTarget == "Body" then
        return player.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or player.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
    elseif Config.AimbotTarget == "Legs+Body" then
        return player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    elseif Config.AimbotTarget == "Body+Head" then
        local head = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local torso = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or player.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        return head or torso
    elseif Config.AimbotTarget == "All" then
        return player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
end

local function isInFOV(targetPos)
    local viewportSize = Camera.ViewportSize
    local screenCenter = Vector2.new(viewportSize.X / 2, viewportSize.Y / 2)
    
    local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPos)
    if not onScreen then return false end
    
    local screenPosition = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
    local distance = (screenPosition - screenCenter).Magnitude
    
    return distance <= Config.AimbotFOV
end

local function getNearestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearestPlayer = nil
    local shortestDistance = math.huge
    local viewportSize = Camera.ViewportSize
    local screenCenter = Vector2.new(viewportSize.X / 2, viewportSize.Y / 2)
    
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            local targetPart = getTargetPart(player)
            if targetPart then
                local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPart.Position)
                if onScreen and isInFOV(targetPart.Position) then
                    local screenPosition = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
                    local distance = (screenPosition - screenCenter).Magnitude
                    if distance < shortestDistance then
                        shortestDistance = distance
                        nearestPlayer = player
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nearestPlayer
end

local function getNearestPlayer()
    local nearestPlayer = nil
    local shortestDistance = math.huge
    local myRootPart = getHumanoidRootPart()
    
    if not myRootPart then return nil end
    
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            local theirRootPart = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if theirRootPart then
                local distance = (myRootPart.Position - theirRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                if distance < shortestDistance then
                    shortestDistance = distance
                    nearestPlayer = player
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nearestPlayer
end

local function getNearestCar()
    local nearestCar = nil
    local shortestDistance = math.huge
    local myRootPart = getHumanoidRootPart()
    
    if not myRootPart then return nil end
    
    for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("VehicleSeat") or (obj:IsA("Model") and obj:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat")) then
            local model = obj:IsA("Model") and obj or obj.Parent
            local primaryPart = model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            
            if primaryPart then
                local distance = (myRootPart.Position - primaryPart.Position).Magnitude
                if distance < shortestDistance and distance < 100 then
                    shortestDistance = distance
                    nearestCar = model
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nearestCar
end

local function getAllNearbyPlayers(radius)
    local nearbyPlayers = {}
    local myRootPart = getHumanoidRootPart()
    
    if not myRootPart then return nearbyPlayers end
    
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            local theirRootPart = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if theirRootPart then
                local distance = (myRootPart.Position - theirRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                if distance <= radius then
                    table.insert(nearbyPlayers, player)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nearbyPlayers
end

-- Feature Functions
local function flingPlayer(targetPlayer)
    local char = getCharacter()
    local myRootPart = getHumanoidRootPart()
    
    if not char or not myRootPart then return end
    if not targetPlayer or not targetPlayer.Character then return end
    
    local targetRootPart = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not targetRootPart then return end
    
    local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, Config.FlingPower, 0)
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bodyVelocity.Parent = myRootPart
    
    myRootPart.CFrame = targetRootPart.CFrame
    
    wait(0.1)
    
    bodyVelocity:Destroy()
    myRootPart.CFrame = myRootPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
end

local function flingNearestPlayer()
    local target = getNearestPlayer()
    if target then
        flingPlayer(target)
        print("🎯 Flinging: " .. target.Name)
    else
        print("❌ No nearby players found")
    end
end

local function flingAllNearby()
    local nearbyPlayers = getAllNearbyPlayers(Config.FlingAllRadius)
    
    if #nearbyPlayers == 0 then
        print("❌ No nearby players found")
        return
    end
    
    print("💥 Flinging " .. #nearbyPlayers .. " nearby players")
    
    for _, player in pairs(nearbyPlayers) do
        spawn(function()
            flingPlayer(player)
        end)
        wait(0.5)
    end
end

-- Aimbot (FIXED - Single RGB circle, only locks players in front)
local aimbotConnection = nil
local fovUpdateConnection = nil

local function startAimbot()
    Config.AimbotEnabled = true
    
    -- Separate connection for FOV circle updates with RGB animation
    fovUpdateConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local viewportSize = Camera.ViewportSize
        local screenCenter = Vector2.new(viewportSize.X / 2, viewportSize.Y / 2)
        
        -- Update circle position and radius
        FOVCircle.Position = screenCenter
        FOVCircle.Radius = Config.AimbotFOV
        FOVCircle.Visible = true
        
        -- RGB color animation
        rgbHue = rgbHue + 0.01
        if rgbHue >= 1 then
            rgbHue = 0
        end
        FOVCircle.Color = Color3.fromHSV(rgbHue, 1, 1)
    end)
    
    -- Main aimbot logic
    aimbotConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Config.AimbotEnabled then return end
        
        -- Only target players within the FOV circle and in front
        local target = getNearestPlayerInFOV()
        if not target or not target.Character then return end
        
        local targetPart = getTargetPart(target)
        if not targetPart then return end
        
        -- Verify target is in front of camera (not behind)
        local cameraLookVector = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        local targetDirection = (targetPart.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Unit
        local dotProduct = cameraLookVector:Dot(targetDirection)
        
        -- Only lock if target is in front (dot product > 0)
        if dotProduct <= 0 then return end
        
        -- Double check if target is still in FOV
        if not isInFOV(targetPart.Position) then return end
        
        -- Smoothly aim at target
        Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, targetPart.Position)
    end)
    
    print("🎯 Aimbot enabled (RGB circle, only targets players in FOV)")
end

local function stopAimbot()
    Config.AimbotEnabled = false
    FOVCircle.Visible = false
    
    if aimbotConnection then
        aimbotConnection:Disconnect()
        aimbotConnection = nil
    end
    
    if fovUpdateConnection then
        fovUpdateConnection:Disconnect()
        fovUpdateConnection = nil
    end
    
    print("❌ Aimbot disabled")
end

-- Fly
local flyConnection = nil
local flyBodyVelocity = nil
local flyBodyGyro = nil

    if not char or not myRootPart then return end
    
    Config.FlyEnabled = true
    
    flyBodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    flyBodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    flyBodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    flyBodyVelocity.Parent = myRootPart
    
    flyBodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    flyBodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    flyBodyGyro.P = 9000
    flyBodyGyro.Parent = myRootPart
    
    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Config.FlyEnabled then return end
        
        local myRootPart = getHumanoidRootPart()
        if not myRootPart then return end
        
        local moveDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection + Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection - Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection - Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection + Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        
        flyBodyVelocity.Velocity = moveDirection * Config.FlySpeed
        flyBodyGyro.CFrame = Camera.CFrame
    end)
    
    print("✈️ Fly enabled")
end

local function stopFly()

    if flyConnection then
        flyConnection:Disconnect()
        flyConnection = nil
    end
    
    if flyBodyVelocity then
        flyBodyVelocity:Destroy()
        flyBodyVelocity = nil
    end
    
    if flyBodyGyro then
        flyBodyGyro:Destroy()
        flyBodyGyro = nil
    end
    
    print("❌ Fly disabled")
end

            bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
            bodyVelocity.Parent = part

        end
    end

-- Backshots Feature (Realistic back and forth motion)
local backshotsConnection = nil
local backshotsTarget = nil
local backshotsCurrentDistance = 0
local backshotsMovingForward = true

    Config.BackshotsEnabled = true
    backshotsTarget = getNearestPlayer()
    backshotsCurrentDistance = Config.BackshotsDistance
    backshotsMovingForward = true
    
    if not backshotsTarget then
        print("❌ No player found for backshots")
        Config.BackshotsEnabled = false
        return
    end
    
    print("😈 Backshots activated on: " .. backshotsTarget.Name)
    
    backshotsConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Config.BackshotsEnabled then return end
        
        local myRootPart = getHumanoidRootPart()
        if not myRootPart then return end
        
        if not backshotsTarget or not backshotsTarget.Character then
            Config.BackshotsEnabled = false
            return
        end
        
        local targetRootPart = backshotsTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not targetRootPart then return end
        
        -- Animate back and forth movement
        if backshotsMovingForward then
            backshotsCurrentDistance = backshotsCurrentDistance - (Config.BackshotsSpeed * 0.1)
            if backshotsCurrentDistance <= 0.5 then
                backshotsMovingForward = false
            end
        else
            backshotsCurrentDistance = backshotsCurrentDistance + (Config.BackshotsSpeed * 0.1)
            if backshotsCurrentDistance >= Config.BackshotsDistance then
                backshotsMovingForward = true
            end
        end
        
        -- Position behind the target with animated distance
        local behindPosition = targetRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, backshotsCurrentDistance)
        
        -- Keep character facing the target's back
        local lookAtTarget = CFrame.new(behindPosition.Position, targetRootPart.Position)
        
        myRootPart.CFrame = lookAtTarget
        
        -- Lock camera to view from behind and slightly above
        local cameraOffset = targetRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, Config.BackshotsDistance + 2)
        Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(cameraOffset.Position, targetRootPart.Position)
    end)
end

    backshotsTarget = nil
    backshotsCurrentDistance = 0
    backshotsMovingForward = true

        color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), text = plr.Name,
        x = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
    })

    local bbDist = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    bbDist.Name = "nt_dist"
    bbDist.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 16)
    bbDist.StudsOffset = TAG_DIST_OFFSET
    bbDist.AlwaysOnTop = true
    bbDist.Adornee = hrp
    bbDist.Parent = hrp

    local distLbl = label({
        parent = bbDist, font = Enum.Font.Code, size = 12,
        color = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220), text = "",
        x = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
    })

    nameTags[plr] = {name = bbName, dist = bbDist, nameLbl = nameLbl, distLbl = distLbl}
end

local function killTag(plr)
    local t = nameTags[plr]
    if t then
        if t.name then t.name:Destroy() end
        if t.dist then t.dist:Destroy() end
    end
    nameTags[plr] = nil
end

local function clearTags()
    for _, t in pairs(nameTags) do
        if t.name then t.name:Destroy() end
        if t.dist then t.dist:Destroy() end
    end
    nameTags = {}
end

local function tickTags()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr == LocalPlayer then continue end
        if TEAM_CHECK and plr.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
            killTag(plr)
            continue
        end

        local char = plr.Character
        local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

        if char and head and hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 and myRoot then
            local dist = (hrp.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if dist <= ESP_RANGE then
                if not nameTags[plr] or not nameTags[plr].name.Parent then
                    killTag(plr)
                    addTag(plr)
                end
                local t = nameTags[plr]
                if t then
                    if t.name.Adornee ~= head then t.name.Adornee = head end
                    if t.dist.Adornee ~= hrp then t.dist.Adornee = hrp end
                    t.distLbl.Text = string.format("%d m", math.floor(dist))
                    local fade = math.clamp(dist / ESP_RANGE, 0, 1) * 0.4
                    t.nameLbl.TextTransparency = fade
                    t.distLbl.TextTransparency = fade
                end
            else
                killTag(plr)
            end
        else
            killTag(plr)
        end
    end
end

local function tickEsp()
    if not espOn then return end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end
    local myPos = myRoot.Position

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr == LocalPlayer then continue end

        if TEAM_CHECK and plr.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
            killHighlight(plr)
            continue
        end

        local char = plr.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

        if char and hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
            local dist = (hrp.Position - myPos).Magnitude
            if dist <= ESP_RANGE then
                local hl = addHighlight(plr)
                if hl and hl.Adornee ~= char then hl.Adornee = char end
                if hl then
                    local t = dist / ESP_RANGE
                    hl.FillTransparency = 0.4 + t * 0.4
                end
            else
                killHighlight(plr)
            end
        else
            killHighlight(plr)
        end
    end

    tickTags()
end

local function score(plr)
    local char = plr.Character
    local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not head or not hrp then return nil end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return nil end

    local worldDist = (hrp.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
    if worldDist > AIM_MAX_DIST then return nil end

    local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
    if not onScreen then return nil end

    local center = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    local screenDist = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
    if screenDist > AIM_FOV then return nil end

    local look = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
    local dir  = (head.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Unit
    local dot  = look:Dot(dir)
    if dot < AIM_FRONT_BIAS then return nil end

    if AIM_WALL_CHECK then
        local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
        local ray = Ray.new(origin, head.Position - origin)
        local ignore = { LocalPlayer.Character, char }
        local hit = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, ignore, false, true)
        if hit then return nil end
    end

    return screenDist - dot * 200
end

local function bestTarget()
    local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr == LocalPlayer or not alive(plr) then continue end
        if AIM_TEAM_CHECK and plr.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then continue end
        local s = score(plr)
        if s and s < bestScore then
            bestScore = s
            best = plr
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function targetHead()
    if not target or not alive(target) then return nil end
    local char = target.Character
    local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    return head and head.Position or nil
end

local function watchKills(plr)
    if plr == LocalPlayer then return end

    local function attach(char)
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        if not hum then return end

        keep(hum.Died:Connect(function()
            local play = false

            if KILL_SOUND_MODE == "target" then
                if target == plr then play = true end
            elseif KILL_SOUND_MODE == "nearby" then
                local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if myRoot and hrp then
                    if (hrp.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude <= KILL_SOUND_RADIUS then
                        play = true
                    end
                end
            elseif KILL_SOUND_MODE == "confirm" then
                if target == plr and (tick() - lastShot) <= KILL_CONFIRM_WINDOW then
                    play = true
                end
            end

            if play then
                playKillSound()
                print("[neon team] kill: " .. plr.Name)
            end
        end))
    end

    if plr.Character then attach(plr.Character) end
    keep(plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(attach))
end

local function onJoin(plr)
    watchKills(plr)
    keep(plr.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
        killHighlight(plr)
        killTag(plr)
        if target == plr then target = nil end
    end))
end

local function onLeave(plr)
    killHighlight(plr)
    killTag(plr)
    if target == plr then target = nil end
end

keep(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin))
keep(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onLeave))
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do onJoin(plr) end

local function shutdown()
    for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    conns = {}

    clearHighlights()
    clearTags()

    if wmGui then wmGui:Destroy() wmGui = nil end
    if hopGui then hopGui:Destroy() hopGui = nil end
    if killSoundInst then killSoundInst:Destroy() killSoundInst = nil end

    espOn = false
    aimOn = false
    target = nil
    wmStatus = nil
    hopOpen = false

    print("[neon team] unloaded. cya.")
end

keep(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end

    if hopOpen then
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.N then
            hideHop()
            print("[neon team] hop cancelled")
        elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Y then
            hideHop()
            doHop()
        elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Z then
            shutdown()
        end
        return
    end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Z then
        shutdown()

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.L then
        showHop()
        print("[neon team] hop prompt shown")

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
        espOn = not espOn
        if not espOn then
            clearHighlights()
            clearTags()
        end
        print("[neon team] esp " .. (espOn and "on" or "off"))
        refreshStatus()

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then
        aimOn = not aimOn
        if aimOn then
            target = bestTarget()
            lastSwitch = tick()
            if target then
                print("[neon team] locked " .. target.Name)
            else
                print("[neon team] nothing visible in front")
                aimOn = false
            end
        else
            target = nil
            print("[neon team] unlocked")
        end
        refreshStatus()

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.K then
        SMOOTH_ON = not SMOOTH_ON
        print(string.format("[neon team] smooth %s (%.2f)", SMOOTH_ON and "on" or "off", SMOOTH_FACTOR))
        refreshStatus()

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftBracket then
        SMOOTH_FACTOR = math.max(SMOOTH_MIN, SMOOTH_FACTOR - SMOOTH_STEP)
        print(string.format("[neon team] smooth factor %.2f", SMOOTH_FACTOR))

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightBracket then
        SMOOTH_FACTOR = math.min(SMOOTH_MAX, SMOOTH_FACTOR + SMOOTH_STEP)
        print(string.format("[neon team] smooth factor %.2f", SMOOTH_FACTOR))
    end
end))

keep(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        lastShot = tick()
    end
end))

keep(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not espOn then return end
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastEspTick < ESP_REFRESH then return end
    lastEspTick = now
    pcall(tickEsp)
end))

keep(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not aimOn then return end
    local now = tick()

    if not target or not alive(target) or (now - lastSwitch >= AIM_SWITCH_DELAY) then
        local best = bestTarget()
        if best and best ~= target then
            target = best
            lastSwitch = now
        elseif not best then
            target = nil
            return
        end
    end

    local head = targetHead()
    if head then
        local desired = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, head)
        if SMOOTH_ON then
            Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(desired, SMOOTH_FACTOR)
        else
            Camera.CFrame = desired
        end
    end
end))

initKillSound()
buildWatermark()
refreshStatus()

local sliders = {}

local function createSlider(name, y, minValue, maxValue, defaultValue, suffix)

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 24)
	label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, y)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 225)
	label.TextSize = 13
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Parent = content

	local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
	bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 7)
	bar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, y + 30)
	bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)
	bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bar.Parent = content

	local barCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	barCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	barCorner.Parent = bar

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 80, 220)
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.Parent = bar

	local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	fillCorner.Parent = fill

	local knob = Instance.new("TextButton")
	knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)
	knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	knob.Text = ""
	knob.Parent = bar

	local knobCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	knobCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	knobCorner.Parent = knob

	local value = defaultValue
	local dragging = false

	local function update(newValue)

		value = math.clamp(newValue, minValue, maxValue)

		local percent =
			(value - minValue) /
			(maxValue - minValue)

		fill.Size = UDim2.new(percent, 0, 1, 0)
		knob.Position = UDim2.new(percent, 0, 0.5, 0)

		if maxValue - minValue >= 10 then
			label.Text =
				name .. ": " .. math.floor(value + 0.5) .. suffix
		else
			label.Text =
				name .. ": " .. string.format("%.2f", value) .. suffix
		end
	end

	local function setFromX(x)

		local percent =
			(x - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) /
			bar.AbsoluteSize.X

		update(
			minValue +
			(maxValue - minValue) *
			math.clamp(percent, 0, 1)
		)
	end

	bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = true
			setFromX(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)

	knob.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = true
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

		if dragging then

			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

				setFromX(input.Position.X)
			end
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = false
		end
	end)

	update(defaultValue)

	local slider = {}

	function slider:Get()
		return value
	end

	function slider:Set(newValue)
		update(newValue)
	end

	return slider
end

-- SLIDERS
--==================================================

	135,

--==================================================
-- TOGGLE
--==================================================

toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	enabled = not enabled

	if enabled then
		toggle.Text = "VOID: ON"
		toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 125, 75)
	else
		toggle.Text = "VOID: OFF"
		toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 67)
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- CAMERA TOGGLE
--==================================================

cameraButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	stableCamera = not stableCamera

	if stableCamera then
		cameraButton.Text = "STABLE CAMERA: ON"
		cameraButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 125, 75)
	else
		cameraButton.Text = "STABLE CAMERA: OFF"
		cameraButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 67)
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- RESET
--==================================================

reset.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	distanceSlider:Set(DEFAULT_DISTANCE)
	voidTimeSlider:Set(DEFAULT_VOID_TIME)
	returnTimeSlider:Set(DEFAULT_RETURN_TIME)

	stableCamera = true
	cameraButton.Text = "STABLE CAMERA: ON"
	cameraButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 125, 75)
end)

--==================================================
-- CHARACTER
--==================================================

local function getCharacter()

	local character = player.Character
		or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

	local root =
		character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if root then
		return character, root
	end
end

--==================================================
-- VOID LOOP
--==================================================

task.spawn(function()

	while gui.Parent do

		task.wait(0.01)

		if enabled and not busy then

			local character, root = getCharacter()

			if character and root then

				busy = true

				local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

				-- Save camera position before teleport
				local savedCameraCFrame

				if stableCamera and camera then
					savedCameraCFrame = camera.CFrame
				end

				-- Save player position
				local returnCFrame = root.CFrame

				VOID_DISTANCE = distanceSlider:Get()
				VOID_TIME = voidTimeSlider:Get()
				RETURN_TIME = returnTimeSlider:Get()

				-- Teleport downward
				root.CFrame =
					returnCFrame *
					CFrame.new(0, -VOID_DISTANCE, 0)

				-- Keep camera visually stable
				if stableCamera and camera and savedCameraCFrame then

					local endTime =
						os.clock() + VOID_TIME

					while os.clock() < endTime do

						if camera and camera.Parent then
							camera.CFrame = savedCameraCFrame
						end

						task.wait()
					end

				else
					task.wait(VOID_TIME)
				end

				-- Return player
				if root and root.Parent then
					root.CFrame = returnCFrame
				end

				-- Restore camera again
				if stableCamera and camera and savedCameraCFrame then
					camera.CFrame = savedCameraCFrame
				end

				task.wait(RETURN_TIME)

				busy = false
			end
		end
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- MINIMIZE / RESTORE
--==================================================

minimize.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	minimized = not minimized

	if minimized then

		-- Hide content
		content.Visible = false

		-- Shrink window
		main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(310, 48)

		-- Change button
		minimize.Text = "□"

	else

		-- Restore window
		main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(310, 380)

		-- Show content
		content.Visible = true

		minimize.Text = "—"
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- CLOSE
--==================================================

close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	enabled = false

	if workspace.CurrentCamera then
		workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType =
			Enum.CameraType.Custom
	end

	gui:Destroy()
end)

--==================================================
-- DRAGGING
--==================================================

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
	or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPosition = main.Position
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if dragging then

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			local delta =
				input.Position - dragStart

			main.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPosition.X.Scale,
				startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPosition.Y.Scale,
				startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
	or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = false
	end
end)
